pages.heading: Chapter 1 – A Quiet Night
text: Luna the little bunny loved looking at the night sky.
Every evening, she sat on her favorite hill and counted the stars one by one.
But tonight felt different.
There was a tiny dark spot where a star should have been.
'I’ll go find the missing star,' Luna decided.

pages.heading: Chapter 2 – Into the Forest
text: Luna hopped down the hill and into the forest.
She heard crickets chirping, leaves rustling, and a bubbling stream.
Fireflies floated around her like tiny lanterns.
She asked if they had seen a fallen star, but they didn’t know.

pages.heading: Chapter 3 – The Wise Owl
text: Luna met Oliver the owl sitting on a tall branch.
She told him about the missing star.
Oliver pointed toward the sparkling river and said he heard a soft twinkle there.

pages.heading: Chapter 4 – The Sparkling River
text: Luna followed the sound of rushing water.
The sparkling river shimmered silver under the moonlight.
She hopped across smooth stones to reach the other side.
She saw a faint glow behind tall reeds.

pages.heading: Chapter 5 – Forest Friends
text: Behind the reeds, she found Finn the fox and Dara the deer.
She told them about the missing star.
They decided to help her search.
Together, they followed tiny flickers of light.

pages.heading: Chapter 6 – The Fallen Star
text: They found a tiny star resting on soft moss.
It flickered as if it were tired.
Luna whispered, 'Are you okay?'
The star warmed gently in response.

pages.heading: Chapter 7 – Back to the Sky
text: Luna and her friends stood under the open sky.
She tossed the little star upward.
It floated back to its empty spot and shone brighter than ever.
'The sky feels complete again,' Luna whispered.
